crossRefs.note: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with…
He asked them to provide animals, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.
For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to…
You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

people.name: Antipatris
people.line: A city where Paul was taken during his transfer to Caesarea.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.
translations.bsb: So the soldiers followed their orders and brought Paul by night to Antipatris.
translations.kjv: Then the soldiers, as it was commanded them, took Paul, and brought him by night to Antipatris.
translations.asv: So the soldiers, as it was commanded them, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.
